The current PassMoE smoke and RockYou tiny runs are trawling-style and not yet comparable to the targeted PassLLM FieldDrop baseline.
A fair PassMoE-vs-PassLLM claim requires the same targeted ClixSense/CSDN records, prompt/PII fields, candidate budget, and duplicate handling.
